description: KPI baseline for P2P signaling server (Phase 5 §5.2)

signaling_go_unit_test_ms.description: Total wall-clock time for `go test ./...` in signaling/ (must be < 30 s)

offer_answer_latency_p99_ms.description: P99 offer→answer relay latency under nominal load (must be < 200 ms)

join_ack_latency_p99_ms.description: P99 room join → ack latency (must be < 100 ms)

concurrent_rooms_supported.description: Minimum concurrent rooms the signaling server must support in load tests

thresholds.description: Any metric worse than baseline by >5% is a KPI regression requiring revert
